verdict.rationale: Quo is a hosted business phone and communications platform. Self-hosting is a fair question for this category, since self-hostable phone systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted or on-prem deployment: everything points to the cloud service at quo.com and api.quo.com, with apps for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Web.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
